newsitem.title: USA: ROSS Technology names Simpson President.
newsitem.headline: ROSS Technology names Simpson President.

text.p: ROSS Technology Inc said Thursday that Jack Simpson was appointed president and chief executive officer.
He was also elected as a member of the board of directors, the company said.
Simpson replaces ROSS Technology founder Roger Ross, who resigned as president and CEO March 4. Since then, board chairman Fred May has served as acting president and CEO.
Most recently, Simpson was president of the Network Systems Group of Scientific-Atlanta Inc and a senior vice president and officer of the corporation.
